9	  each reading one field of `World` and nothing else. Attribute accessors of an atom carry the

14	  - no thresholds, no comparisons against constants, no temporal lookback: a threshold is a rule's

19

22	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.World
23	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Assumptions
24	
25	namespace TrafficSpec
26	
27	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
28	-- Geometry helpers for the `rel_*` atoms (exact rationals; the one square root is an integer
29	-- square root at micrometre resolution).
30	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
31	namespace Geom
32	def vsub (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.sub a.1 b.1, Q.sub a.2 b.2)
33	def vadd (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.add a.1 b.1, Q.add a.2 b.2)
34	def dot (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.add (Q.mul a.1 b.1) (Q.mul a.2 b.2)
35	/-- 2-D cross product `a × b`; positive when `b` is to the left of `a`. -/
36	def cross (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.sub (Q.mul a.1 b.2) (Q.mul a.2 b.1)
37	def normSq (a : Vec) : Q := dot a a
38	/-- Square root of a non-negative quantity in metres, floored to micrometres. -/
39	def sqrtMicro (q : Q) : Q :=
40	  if q.num ≤ 0 then Q.zero
41	  else
42	    let scaled : Int := (q.num * 1000000000000) / (q.den : Int)   -- µm²
43	    Units.micrometres (Int.ofNat (isqrt scaled.toNat))
44	def norm (a : Vec) : Q := sqrtMicro (normSq a)
45	/-- The unit vector along `a`; `none` for the zero vector only. `a` is first divided by its larger
46	    absolute component, so the vector normalised has length between 1 and √2 whatever `a`'s scale,
47	    and then by that length taken to micrometres (`norm`). The result is the exact unit vector times
48	    a factor of at least 1 and below 1 + 2·10⁻⁶, and is exact where the scaled length is a whole
49	    number of micrometres (every axis-aligned direction). -/
50	def unit (a : Vec) : Option Vec :=
51	  let m := Q.max (Q.abs a.1) (Q.abs a.2)
52	  if Q.isZero m then none
53	  else
54	    let b := (Q.div a.1 m, Q.div a.2 m)
55	    let n := norm b
56	    some (Q.div b.1 n, Q.div b.2 n)
57	/-- Components of `v` in the frame of heading `h` (longitudinal, lateral); lateral positive = left.
58	    `h` is read as a direction (`unit`), whatever its length; `v` keeps its own. -/
59	def inFrame (h v : Vec) : Option (Q × Q) := do
60	  let u ← unit h
61	  pure (dot u v, cross u v)
62	/-- Distance from a point to a segment. -/
63	def segmentDistance (p a b : Vec) : Q :=
64	  let ab := vsub b a
65	  let ap := vsub p a
66	  let l2 := normSq ab
67	  if Q.isZero l2 then norm ap
68	  else
69	    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot ap ab) l2))
70	    norm (vsub p (vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)))
71	/-- Whether a point lies inside a polygon (ray casting), for footprint-in-region tests. -/
72	def inPolygon (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
73	  let n := poly.length
74	  if n < 3 then false
75	  else
76	    let edges := (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
77	    let crossings := edges.filter fun (a, b) =>
78	      let (ax, ay) := a; let (bx, by_) := b
79	      ((Q.le ay p.2) != (Q.le by_ p.2)) &&
80	        -- x-intersection of the edge with the horizontal line through p, compared with p.x
81	        (let dy := Q.sub by_ ay
82	         !Q.isZero dy &&
83	         Q.lt p.1 (Q.add ax (Q.div (Q.mul (Q.sub p.2 ay) (Q.sub bx ax)) dy)))
84	    crossings.length % 2 == 1
85	/-- The sign of `(b − a) × (c − a)`: 1 when `c` is to the left of `ab`, −1 to its right, 0 on its line. -/
86	def orient (a b c : Vec) : Int :=
87	  let k := (cross (vsub b a) (vsub c a)).num
88	  if k > 0 then 1 else if k < 0 then -1 else 0
89	/-- Whether `p` lies on the closed segment `ab`, given that it lies on its line. -/
90	def withinBox (p a b : Vec) : Bool :=
91	  Q.le (Q.min a.1 b.1) p.1 && Q.le p.1 (Q.max a.1 b.1) && Q.le (Q.min a.2 b.2) p.2 && Q.le p.2 (Q.max a.2 b.2)
92	/-- Whether the closed segments `ab` and `cd` share a point, touching and collinear overlap included. -/
93	def segmentsIntersect (a b c d : Vec) : Bool :=
94	  let o1 := orient a b c; let o2 := orient a b d; let o3 := orient c d a; let o4 := orient c d b
95	  (o1 * o2 < 0 && o3 * o4 < 0) || (o1 == 0 && withinBox c a b) || (o2 == 0 && withinBox d a b)
96	    || (o3 == 0 && withinBox a c d) || (o4 == 0 && withinBox b c d)
97	/-- The edges of a polygon, the last vertex closing to the first. -/
98	def edges (poly : List Vec) : List (Vec × Vec) :=
99	  let n := poly.length
100	  (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
101	/-- Whether two polygons share a point as closed sets: an edge of one meets an edge of the other
102	    (touching counts), or one lies inside the other. Exact. -/
103	def polygonsOverlap (p q : List Vec) : Bool :=
104	  (edges p).any (fun (a, b) => (edges q).any fun (c, d) => segmentsIntersect a b c d)
105	    || p.any (inPolygon · q) || q.any (inPolygon · p)
106	/-- Distance from a point to a polygon's boundary: zero inside, the nearest edge outside. -/
107	def polygonDistance (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Q :=
108	  match poly with
109	  | [] => none
110	  | [a] => some (norm (vsub p a))
111	  | _ =>
112	    if inPolygon p poly then some Q.zero
113	    else
114	      let n := poly.length
115	      let ds := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentDistance p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
116	      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
117	/-- The point of a segment nearest a point. -/
118	def segmentNearest (p a b : Vec) : Vec :=
119	  let ab := vsub b a
120	  let l2 := normSq ab
121	  if Q.isZero l2 then a
122	  else
123	    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot (vsub p a) ab) l2))
124	    vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)
125	/-- The point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point. -/
126	def nearestPoint (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
127	  match poly with
128	  | [] => none
129	  | [a] => some a
130	  | _ =>
131	    let n := poly.length
132	    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
133	    cs.foldl (fun acc c => match acc with
134	      | none => some c
135	      | some b => if Q.lt (normSq (vsub p c)) (normSq (vsub p b)) then some c else some b) none
136	/-- Every point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point: the nearest point of each edge whose
137	    distance is the least, so a tie keeps every equally near point whatever the vertex order. -/
138	def nearestPoints (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Vec :=
139	  match poly with
140	  | [] => []
141	  | [a] => [a]
142	  | _ =>
143	    let n := poly.length
144	    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
145	    match cs.map fun c => normSq (vsub p c) with
146	    | [] => []
147	    | d :: ds =>
148	      let m := ds.foldl Q.min d
149	      cs.filter fun c => Q.eq (normSq (vsub p c)) m
150	/-- The vector from the nearest point of polygon `p` to the nearest point of polygon `q`: zero when
151	    they share a point (`polygonsOverlap`), otherwise the shortest vector joining a vertex of one to
152	    the nearest point of the other's boundary, which for two convex polygons is the same for every
153	    nearest pair. `none` for an empty polygon. -/
154	def nearestOffset (p q : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
155	  if polygonsOverlap p q then some (Q.zero, Q.zero)
156	  else
157	    let fromP := p.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c q).map (vsub · c)
158	    let fromQ := q.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c p).map (vsub c ·)
159	    (fromP ++ fromQ).foldl (fun acc d => match acc with
160	      | none => some d
161	      | some e => if Q.lt (normSq d) (normSq e) then some d else some e) none
162	/-- The interval a polygon covers along the direction `u`, measured from `o`: (lowest, highest). -/
163	def span (u o : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option (Q × Q) :=
164	  match poly.map fun c => dot u (vsub c o) with
165	  | [] => none
166	  | x :: xs => some (xs.foldl Q.min x, xs.foldl Q.max x)
167	/-- Twice the signed area of a polygon (the shoelace sum). -/
168	def area2 (poly : List Vec) : Q :=
169	  (edges poly).foldl (fun acc (a, b) => Q.add acc (cross a b)) Q.zero
170	/-- Whether a polygon's boundary crosses or touches itself: two edges that are not neighbours
171	    meet, or two neighbouring edges fold back along one line. -/
172	def selfIntersects (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
173	  let es := (edges poly).toArray
174	  let n := es.size
175	  (List.range n).any fun i => (List.range n).any fun j =>
176	    if j ≤ i then false
177	    else
178	      let (a, b) := es[i]!
179	      let (c, d) := es[j]!
180	      if j == i + 1 then orient a b d == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub b a) (vsub d c)) Q.zero
181	      else if i == 0 && j + 1 == n then orient c d b == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub d c) (vsub b a)) Q.zero
182	      else segmentsIntersect a b c d
183	/-- A simple polygon: at least three vertices, a non-zero area, and a boundary that neither crosses
184	    nor touches itself (a repeated vertex makes two edges that are not neighbours meet). -/
185	def simplePolygon (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
186	  poly.length ≥ 3 && !Q.isZero (area2 poly) && !selfIntersects poly
187	/-- Whether a point lies on a polygon's boundary. Exact. -/
188	def onBoundary (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
189	  (edges poly).any fun (a, b) => orient a b p == 0 && withinBox p a b
190	/-- The parameters `t` at which the line `p + t·u` meets the polygon's boundary: one per edge it
191	    crosses or touches, and both ends of an edge it runs along. `u` is not the zero vector. -/
192	def lineCrossings (p u : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Q :=
193	  (edges poly).flatMap fun (a, b) =>
194	    let d := vsub b a
195	    let w := vsub a p
196	    let den := cross u d
197	    if Q.isZero den then
198	      if Q.isZero (cross u w) then [Q.div (dot w u) (dot u u), Q.div (dot (vsub b p) u) (dot u u)] else []
199	    else

277	/-- Whether kind `a` refines kind `b`, reflexively and transitively. -/
278	def StructureKind.refines (a b : StructureKind) : Bool := a == b || a.ancestors.contains b
279	
280	/-- Whether a source that cannot tell kind `m` (it is among `unobservedKinds`) leaves this structure's
281	    membership of `m`'s kinds open: always where `m` refines no kind other than an abstract one;
282	    otherwise only where the structure is labelled `m` or a kind `m` refines, since a structure of any
283	    other kind is known not to be one. -/
284	def Structure.maskApplies (st : Structure) (m : StructureKind) : Bool :=
285	  (m.parent?.filter (!·.isAbstract)).isNone || m.refines st.kind
286	
287	/-- Whether a structure is of kind `k`: unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
288	    structure, is `k` or a kind `k` refines (the label cannot be trusted for `k`); true where the
289	    structure's kind refines `k`; unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
290	    structure, refines `k`; false otherwise. A parent never implies a kind refining it, two kinds
291	    refining one parent never imply each other, and a kind the source cannot tell never makes a known
292	    parent unknown. An abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it: true where the structure
293	    is of one of them, unknown where it is of none and unknown for one, false otherwise. -/
294	def Structure.isOfKind (st : Structure) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
295	  let masked := st.unobservedKinds.filter st.maskApplies
296	  let concrete (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
297	    if masked.any (k.refines ·) then none
298	    else if st.kind.refines k then some true
299	    else if masked.any (·.refines k) then none
300	    else some false
301	  if k.isAbstract then
302	    let vs := (StructureKind.all.filter (·.parent? == some k)).map concrete
303	    if vs.contains (some true) then some true else if vs.contains none then none else some false
304	  else concrete k
305

402	/-- The rectangle a road user's body covers on the ground, from its position, heading and
403	    half-extents; `none` when one of them is not observed. -/
404	def footprint (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List Vec) := do
405	  let p ← kin_position s x
406	  let h ← kin_heading s x
407	  let (hl, hw, _) ← kin_extent s x
408	  let u ← Geom.unit h
409	  let v := (Q.neg u.2, u.1)
410	  let corner (a b : Q) : Vec := Geom.vadd p (Q.add (Q.mul a u.1) (Q.mul b v.1), Q.add (Q.mul a u.2) (Q.mul b v.2))
411	  pure [corner hl hw, corner hl (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) hw]
412	
413	/-- Ground distance from a road user's body to a region: zero when the footprint overlaps the
414	    boundary, otherwise the nearest approach between the two outlines. Without a footprint (no
415	    extent or heading observed) the reference point is used; a point-like structure is measured
416	    to its reference point. -/
417	def st_region_geometry_distance (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Option Q := do
418	  let p ← kin_position s x
419	  match st_region_geometry_boundary s r, footprint s x with
420	  | some poly, some fp =>
421	    if Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some Q.zero
422	    else
423	      let ds := fp.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · poly) ++ poly.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · fp)
424	      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
425	  | some poly, none => Geom.polygonDistance p poly
426	  | none, fp =>
427	    let c ← st_region_geometry_position s r
428	    match fp with
429	    | some poly => Geom.polygonDistance c poly
430	    | none => some (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub c p))

484	def dev_human_direction_role (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option HumanRole := (s.device d).bind (·.humanRole)
485	def dev_human_direction_indication (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option HumanIndication := (s.device d).bind (·.humanIndication)
486	def dev_governs (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) (r : RegionId) : Option Bool :=
487	  (s.device d).bind fun dv => if dv.governsObserved then some (dv.governs.contains r) else none
488	def dev_governs_regions (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option (List RegionId) :=
489	  (s.device d).bind fun dv => if dv.governsObserved then some dv.governs else none
490	def dev_position (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Vec := (s.device d).bind (·.position)
491	def dev_inoperative (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := (s.device d).bind (·.inoperative)
492	/-- The devices of a kind present in the scene. -/
493	def devicesOfKind (s : Scene) (k : DeviceKind) : List DeviceId :=
494	  (s.devices.filter (·.kind == k)).map (·.id)
495	/-- The devices a quantifier over a kind ranges over: those of the kind, and those whose kind the
496	    source cannot tell, which may be of it. -/
497	def deviceCandidates (s : Scene) (k : DeviceKind) : List DeviceId :=
498	  (s.devices.filter fun d => d.kind == k || d.unobservedKinds.contains k).map (·.id)
499	
500	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
501	-- Signals emitted by road users
502	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
503	def sig_turn_indicator (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option TurnIndicatorState := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.turnIndicator)
504	def sig_brake_lamp (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.brakeLamp)
505	def sig_hazard (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.hazard)
506	def sig_headlamp (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option HeadlampState := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.headlamp)
507	def sig_position_lamp (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.positionLamp)
508	def sig_warning_lamp (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List WarningLamp) := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.warningLamps)
509	/-- A warning lamp of the given colour lit, in any mode or facing. -/
510	def sig_warning_lamp_colour (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (c : LampColour) : Option Bool :=
511	  (sig_warning_lamp s x).map (·.any (·.colour == c))
512	def sig_warning_lamp_shows (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (c : LampColour) (m : LampMode) : Option Bool :=
513	  (sig_warning_lamp s x).map (·.any fun l => l.colour == c && l.mode == m)
514	def sig_siren (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.siren)
515	def sig_horn (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.horn)
516	def sig_hand_signal (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option HandSignal := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.handSignal)
517	def sig_door_open (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List DoorSide) := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.doorsOpen)
518	def sig_door_open_side (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (side : DoorSide) : Option Bool := (sig_door_open s x).map (·.contains side)
519	def sig_compression_brake (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.compressionBrake)
520	
521	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
522	-- Environment
523	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
524	def env_darkness (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.darkness
525	def env_precipitation (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.precipitation
526	def env_wet_road (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.wetRoad
527	def env_ice_or_snow (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.iceOrSnow
528	def env_visibility (s : Scene) : Option Q := s.env.visibility
529	def env_civil_time (s : Scene) : Option CivilTime := s.env.civilTime
530	
531	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
532	-- Relations between road users. Measured where the source supplies them, otherwise computed
533	-- from kinematics. `none` when a needed kinematic is missing.
534	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
535	def rel_centre_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
536	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.centreDistance) with
537	  | some d => some d
538	  | none => do
539	    let pa ← kin_position s a
540	    let pb ← kin_position s b
541	    pure (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub pb pa))
542	
543	/-- Components of `b`'s position relative to `a` in `a`'s heading frame (longitudinal, lateral). -/
544	private def relFrame (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) := do
545	  let pa ← kin_position s a
546	  let pb ← kin_position s b
547	  let ha ← kin_heading s a
548	  Geom.inFrame ha (Geom.vsub pb pa)
549	
550	/-- The gap between the two bodies: the vector from the nearest point of `a`'s footprint to the
551	    nearest point of `b`'s, each footprint read with its own heading and extent, given as its
552	    lengths along and across `a`'s heading (longitudinal, lateral). Neither is ever negative; both
553	    are zero exactly when the footprints touch or overlap. `none` when either footprint is not
554	    observed, and when a supplied gap has a negative component. -/
555	def rel_surface_gap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) :=
556	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.surfaceGap) with
557	  | some g => if Q.isNonneg g.1 && Q.isNonneg g.2 then some g else none
558	  | none => do
559	    let fa ← footprint s a
560	    let fb ← footprint s b
561	    let d ← Geom.nearestOffset fa fb
562	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
563	    let (lon, lat) ← Geom.inFrame ha d
564	    pure (Q.abs lon, Q.abs lat)
565	def rel_surface_gap_longitudinal (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.1)
566	def rel_surface_gap_lateral (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.2)
567	/-- The distance between the nearest points of the two bodies, the gap's length: zero on contact
568	    or overlap, never negative. -/
569	def rel_surface_gap_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map Geom.norm
570	
571	/-- `a` and `b` share a lane and `a` is ahead of `b` along `a`'s heading. The lane is any region both
572	    occupy that is of kind lane (`Structure.isOfKind`): unknown when `a` is ahead and no shared region
573	    is known to be a lane but one may be. -/
574	def rel_ahead_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
575	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.aAheadOfB) with
576	  | some v => some v
577	  | none => do
578	    let ra ← rel_occupies_regions s a
579	    let rb ← rel_occupies_regions s b
580	    let (lon, _) ← relFrame s a b
581	    if !Q.lt lon Q.zero then some false
582	    else
583	      let shared := (s.structures.filter fun st => ra.contains st.id && rb.contains st.id).map (·.isOfKind .lane)
584	      if shared.contains (some true) then some true
585	      else if shared.contains none then none
586	      else some false
587	def rel_ahead_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s a b
588	def rel_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s b a
589	
590	/-- Signed overlap of the two footprints along `a`'s heading, each read with its own heading and
591	    extent: the length their projections on that axis share, positive when the bodies are side by
592	    side, otherwise the gap between the projections negated. A projection: it reads nothing across
593	    the axis, so a positive value is no contact and a negative one no distance between the bodies. -/
594	def rel_longitudinal_overlap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
595	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.longitudinalOverlap) with
596	  | some v => some v
597	  | none => do
598	    let pa ← kin_position s a
599	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
600	    let u ← Geom.unit ha
601	    let fa ← footprint s a
602	    let fb ← footprint s b
603	    let (loA, hiA) ← Geom.span u pa fa
604	    let (loB, hiB) ← Geom.span u pa fb
605	    pure (Q.sub (Q.min hiA hiB) (Q.max loA loB))
606	
607	/-- Headings opposed (cosine below `-cosTol`) and the distance decreasing. -/
608	def rel_oncoming (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
609	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.oncoming) with
610	  | some v => some v
611	  | none => do
612	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
613	    let hb ← kin_heading s b
614	    let pa ← kin_position s a
615	    let pb ← kin_position s b
616	    let va ← kin_velocity s a
617	    let vb ← kin_velocity s b
618	    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
619	    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
620	    let closing := Q.lt (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub pb pa) (Geom.vsub vb va)) Q.zero
621	    pure (Q.lt (Geom.dot ua ub) (Q.neg cosTol) && closing)
622	
623	/-- Headings aligned (cosine above `cosTol`). -/
624	def rel_same_direction (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
625	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.sameDirection) with
626	  | some v => some v
627	  | none => do
628	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
629	    let hb ← kin_heading s b
630	    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
631	    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
632	    pure (Q.gt (Geom.dot ua ub) cosTol)
633	
634	/-- `b` relative to `a` in `a`'s frame: (longitudinal, lateral), lateral positive to the left. -/
635	def rel_bearing (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Vec :=
636	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.bearing) with
637	  | some v => some v
638	  | none => relFrame s a b
639	def rel_bearing_right (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.2 Q.zero
640	def rel_bearing_left (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.2 Q.zero
641	def rel_bearing_ahead (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.1 Q.zero
642	def rel_bearing_behind (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.1 Q.zero
643	
644	/-- The bodies touch or overlap. -/
645	def rel_contact (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
646	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.contact) with
647	  | some v => some v
648	  | none => (rel_surface_gap s a b).map fun g => Q.le g.1 Q.zero && Q.le g.2 Q.zero
649	
650	/-- `b` is in `a`'s line of sight, as the source tested it; never computed. -/
651	def rel_visible (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.relation a b).bind (·.visible)
652	
653	end TrafficSpec

/-
  TRAINING SPLIT of TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms. Generated from Core/Vocab/Atoms.lean by
  ontology_provenance/nrs_tools/atoms_train.py: the definitions of the atoms whose only textual
  support is a test line are omitted. Do not edit; regenerate.
-/
/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
  The bijection with the atoms of ATOMS.md: exactly one definition per atom id, named `family_name`,
  each reading one field of `World` and nothing else. Attribute accessors of an atom carry the
  atom's name plus a suffix (`dev_traffic_signal_shows`, `ru_rider_posture_on_seat`).

  Rules of this file, held by the doctor:
  - every `\`family.name\`` in ATOMS.md has exactly one `def family_name` here and vice versa;
  - no thresholds, no comparisons against constants, no temporal lookback: a threshold is a rule's
    or a derived concept's business;
  - the `rel_*` atoms may compute geometry from kinematics, because their contract says they are
    "computed from kinematics; listed because a source may supply them measured" — a measured
    value, when the source gives one, is preferred; `rel_visible` reads a measured value only.

  Every atom is three-valued: `none` is "not observed on this source".
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.World
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Assumptions

namespace TrafficSpec

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Geometry helpers for the `rel_*` atoms (exact rationals; the one square root is an integer
-- square root at micrometre resolution).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
namespace Geom
def vsub (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.sub a.1 b.1, Q.sub a.2 b.2)
def vadd (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.add a.1 b.1, Q.add a.2 b.2)
def dot (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.add (Q.mul a.1 b.1) (Q.mul a.2 b.2)
/-- 2-D cross product `a × b`; positive when `b` is to the left of `a`. -/
def cross (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.sub (Q.mul a.1 b.2) (Q.mul a.2 b.1)
def normSq (a : Vec) : Q := dot a a
/-- Square root of a non-negative quantity in metres, floored to micrometres. -/
def sqrtMicro (q : Q) : Q :=
  if q.num ≤ 0 then Q.zero
  else
    let scaled : Int := (q.num * 1000000000000) / (q.den : Int)   -- µm²
    Units.micrometres (Int.ofNat (isqrt scaled.toNat))
def norm (a : Vec) : Q := sqrtMicro (normSq a)
/-- The unit vector along `a`; `none` for the zero vector only. `a` is first divided by its larger
    absolute component, so the vector normalised has length between 1 and √2 whatever `a`'s scale,
    and then by that length taken to micrometres (`norm`). The result is the exact unit vector times
    a factor of at least 1 and below 1 + 2·10⁻⁶, and is exact where the scaled length is a whole
    number of micrometres (every axis-aligned direction). -/
def unit (a : Vec) : Option Vec :=
  let m := Q.max (Q.abs a.1) (Q.abs a.2)
  if Q.isZero m then none
  else
    let b := (Q.div a.1 m, Q.div a.2 m)
    let n := norm b
    some (Q.div b.1 n, Q.div b.2 n)
/-- Components of `v` in the frame of heading `h` (longitudinal, lateral); lateral positive = left.
    `h` is read as a direction (`unit`), whatever its length; `v` keeps its own. -/
def inFrame (h v : Vec) : Option (Q × Q) := do
  let u ← unit h
  pure (dot u v, cross u v)
/-- Distance from a point to a segment. -/
def segmentDistance (p a b : Vec) : Q :=
  let ab := vsub b a
  let ap := vsub p a
  let l2 := normSq ab
  if Q.isZero l2 then norm ap
  else
    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot ap ab) l2))
    norm (vsub p (vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)))
/-- Whether a point lies inside a polygon (ray casting), for footprint-in-region tests. -/
def inPolygon (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  let n := poly.length
  if n < 3 then false
  else
    let edges := (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
    let crossings := edges.filter fun (a, b) =>
      let (ax, ay) := a; let (bx, by_) := b
      ((Q.le ay p.2) != (Q.le by_ p.2)) &&
        -- x-intersection of the edge with the horizontal line through p, compared with p.x
        (let dy := Q.sub by_ ay
         !Q.isZero dy &&
         Q.lt p.1 (Q.add ax (Q.div (Q.mul (Q.sub p.2 ay) (Q.sub bx ax)) dy)))
    crossings.length % 2 == 1
/-- The sign of `(b − a) × (c − a)`: 1 when `c` is to the left of `ab`, −1 to its right, 0 on its line. -/
def orient (a b c : Vec) : Int :=
  let k := (cross (vsub b a) (vsub c a)).num
  if k > 0 then 1 else if k < 0 then -1 else 0
/-- Whether `p` lies on the closed segment `ab`, given that it lies on its line. -/
def withinBox (p a b : Vec) : Bool :=
  Q.le (Q.min a.1 b.1) p.1 && Q.le p.1 (Q.max a.1 b.1) && Q.le (Q.min a.2 b.2) p.2 && Q.le p.2 (Q.max a.2 b.2)
/-- Whether the closed segments `ab` and `cd` share a point, touching and collinear overlap included. -/
def segmentsIntersect (a b c d : Vec) : Bool :=
  let o1 := orient a b c; let o2 := orient a b d; let o3 := orient c d a; let o4 := orient c d b
  (o1 * o2 < 0 && o3 * o4 < 0) || (o1 == 0 && withinBox c a b) || (o2 == 0 && withinBox d a b)
    || (o3 == 0 && withinBox a c d) || (o4 == 0 && withinBox b c d)
/-- The edges of a polygon, the last vertex closing to the first. -/
def edges (poly : List Vec) : List (Vec × Vec) :=
  let n := poly.length
  (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
/-- Whether two polygons share a point as closed sets: an edge of one meets an edge of the other
    (touching counts), or one lies inside the other. Exact. -/
def polygonsOverlap (p q : List Vec) : Bool :=
  (edges p).any (fun (a, b) => (edges q).any fun (c, d) => segmentsIntersect a b c d)
    || p.any (inPolygon · q) || q.any (inPolygon · p)
/-- Distance from a point to a polygon's boundary: zero inside, the nearest edge outside. -/
def polygonDistance (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Q :=
  match poly with
  | [] => none
  | [a] => some (norm (vsub p a))
  | _ =>
    if inPolygon p poly then some Q.zero
    else
      let n := poly.length
      let ds := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentDistance p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
/-- The point of a segment nearest a point. -/
def segmentNearest (p a b : Vec) : Vec :=
  let ab := vsub b a
  let l2 := normSq ab
  if Q.isZero l2 then a
  else
    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot (vsub p a) ab) l2))
    vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)
/-- The point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point. -/
def nearestPoint (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
  match poly with
  | [] => none
  | [a] => some a
  | _ =>
    let n := poly.length
    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
    cs.foldl (fun acc c => match acc with
      | none => some c
      | some b => if Q.lt (normSq (vsub p c)) (normSq (vsub p b)) then some c else some b) none
/-- Every point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point: the nearest point of each edge whose
    distance is the least, so a tie keeps every equally near point whatever the vertex order. -/
def nearestPoints (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Vec :=
  match poly with
  | [] => []
  | [a] => [a]
  | _ =>
    let n := poly.length
    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
    match cs.map fun c => normSq (vsub p c) with
    | [] => []
    | d :: ds =>
      let m := ds.foldl Q.min d
      cs.filter fun c => Q.eq (normSq (vsub p c)) m
/-- The vector from the nearest point of polygon `p` to the nearest point of polygon `q`: zero when
    they share a point (`polygonsOverlap`), otherwise the shortest vector joining a vertex of one to
    the nearest point of the other's boundary, which for two convex polygons is the same for every
    nearest pair. `none` for an empty polygon. -/
def nearestOffset (p q : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
  if polygonsOverlap p q then some (Q.zero, Q.zero)
  else
    let fromP := p.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c q).map (vsub · c)
    let fromQ := q.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c p).map (vsub c ·)
    (fromP ++ fromQ).foldl (fun acc d => match acc with
      | none => some d
      | some e => if Q.lt (normSq d) (normSq e) then some d else some e) none
/-- The interval a polygon covers along the direction `u`, measured from `o`: (lowest, highest). -/
def span (u o : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option (Q × Q) :=
  match poly.map fun c => dot u (vsub c o) with
  | [] => none
  | x :: xs => some (xs.foldl Q.min x, xs.foldl Q.max x)
/-- Twice the signed area of a polygon (the shoelace sum). -/
def area2 (poly : List Vec) : Q :=
  (edges poly).foldl (fun acc (a, b) => Q.add acc (cross a b)) Q.zero
/-- Whether a polygon's boundary crosses or touches itself: two edges that are not neighbours
    meet, or two neighbouring edges fold back along one line. -/
def selfIntersects (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  let es := (edges poly).toArray
  let n := es.size
  (List.range n).any fun i => (List.range n).any fun j =>
    if j ≤ i then false
    else
      let (a, b) := es[i]!
      let (c, d) := es[j]!
      if j == i + 1 then orient a b d == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub b a) (vsub d c)) Q.zero
      else if i == 0 && j + 1 == n then orient c d b == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub d c) (vsub b a)) Q.zero
      else segmentsIntersect a b c d
/-- A simple polygon: at least three vertices, a non-zero area, and a boundary that neither crosses
    nor touches itself (a repeated vertex makes two edges that are not neighbours meet). -/
def simplePolygon (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  poly.length ≥ 3 && !Q.isZero (area2 poly) && !selfIntersects poly
/-- Whether a point lies on a polygon's boundary. Exact. -/
def onBoundary (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  (edges poly).any fun (a, b) => orient a b p == 0 && withinBox p a b
/-- The parameters `t` at which the line `p + t·u` meets the polygon's boundary: one per edge it
    crosses or touches, and both ends of an edge it runs along. `u` is not the zero vector. -/
def lineCrossings (p u : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Q :=
  (edges poly).flatMap fun (a, b) =>
    let d := vsub b a
    let w := vsub a p
    let den := cross u d
    if Q.isZero den then
      if Q.isZero (cross u w) then [Q.div (dot w u) (dot u u), Q.div (dot (vsub b p) u) (dot u u)] else []
    else
      let s := Q.div (cross w u) den
      if Q.le Q.zero s && Q.le s (Q.ofInt 1) then [Q.div (cross w d) den] else []
end Geom

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Road users
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def hasClass (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (c : RoadUserClass) : Option Bool :=
  (s.user x).bind fun u => if u.unobservedClasses.contains c then none else u.classes.map (·.contains c)

def ru_motor_vehicle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .motorVehicle
def ru_motorcycle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .motorcycle
def ru_moped (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .moped
def ru_bus (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .bus
def ru_transit_bus (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .transitBus
def ru_school_bus (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .schoolBus
def ru_taxicab (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .taxicab
def ru_tour_bus_or_limousine (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .tourBusOrLimousine
def ru_truck (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .truck
def ru_commercial_motor_vehicle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .commercialMotorVehicle

-- Road structure and occupancy
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Whether kind `a` refines kind `b`, reflexively and transitively. -/
def StructureKind.refines (a b : StructureKind) : Bool := a == b || a.ancestors.contains b

/-- Whether a source that cannot tell kind `m` (it is among `unobservedKinds`) leaves this structure's
    membership of `m`'s kinds open: always where `m` refines no kind other than an abstract one;
    otherwise only where the structure is labelled `m` or a kind `m` refines, since a structure of any
    other kind is known not to be one. -/
def Structure.maskApplies (st : Structure) (m : StructureKind) : Bool :=
  (m.parent?.filter (!·.isAbstract)).isNone || m.refines st.kind

/-- Whether a structure is of kind `k`: unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
    structure, is `k` or a kind `k` refines (the label cannot be trusted for `k`); true where the
    structure's kind refines `k`; unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
    structure, refines `k`; false otherwise. A parent never implies a kind refining it, two kinds
    refining one parent never imply each other, and a kind the source cannot tell never makes a known
    parent unknown. An abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it: true where the structure
    is of one of them, unknown where it is of none and unknown for one, false otherwise. -/
def Structure.isOfKind (st : Structure) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
  let masked := st.unobservedKinds.filter st.maskApplies
  let concrete (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
    if masked.any (k.refines ·) then none
    else if st.kind.refines k then some true
    else if masked.any (·.refines k) then none
    else some false
  if k.isAbstract then
    let vs := (StructureKind.all.filter (·.parent? == some k)).map concrete
    if vs.contains (some true) then some true else if vs.contains none then none else some false
  else concrete k

/-- Whether a region is of a kind (`Structure.isOfKind`); unknown for a region not in the scene. -/
def isKind (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
  (s.structure? r).bind (·.isOfKind k)

    `r'` where `r` is first from the left, unknown where neither the neighbour nor the lane's place
    is observed. -/
def st_lane_left_of (s : Scene) (r r' : RegionId) : Option Bool :=
  match st_lane_adjacency_left s r with
  | some n => some (n == r')
  | none => if st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s r == some 1 then some false else none

    `r'` where `r` is last of the lanes in its direction. -/

  match st_lane_adjacency_right s r with
  | some n => some (n == r')
  | none =>
    match st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s r, st_lane_adjacency_count s r with
    | some o, some n => if o == n then some false else none
    | _, _ => none

/-- Geometry accessors every structure atom shares: the reference point and the boundary polygon. -/
def st_region_geometry (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option (Option Vec × Option (List Vec)) :=
  (s.structure? r).map fun st => (st.position, st.boundary)
def st_region_geometry_position (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option Vec := (s.structure? r).bind (·.position)

/-- The rectangle a road user's body covers on the ground, from its position, heading and
    half-extents; `none` when one of them is not observed. -/
def footprint (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List Vec) := do
  let p ← kin_position s x
  let h ← kin_heading s x
  let (hl, hw, _) ← kin_extent s x
  let u ← Geom.unit h
  let v := (Q.neg u.2, u.1)
  let corner (a b : Q) : Vec := Geom.vadd p (Q.add (Q.mul a u.1) (Q.mul b v.1), Q.add (Q.mul a u.2) (Q.mul b v.2))
  pure [corner hl hw, corner hl (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) hw]

/-- Ground distance from a road user's body to a region: zero when the footprint overlaps the
    boundary, otherwise the nearest approach between the two outlines. Without a footprint (no
    extent or heading observed) the reference point is used; a point-like structure is measured
    to its reference point. -/
def st_region_geometry_distance (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Option Q := do
  let p ← kin_position s x
  match st_region_geometry_boundary s r, footprint s x with
  | some poly, some fp =>
    if Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some Q.zero
    else
      let ds := fp.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · poly) ++ poly.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · fp)
      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
  | some poly, none => Geom.polygonDistance p poly
  | none, fp =>
    let c ← st_region_geometry_position s r
    match fp with
    | some poly => Geom.polygonDistance c poly
    | none => some (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub c p))
/-- The regions present in the scene known to be of a kind (`Structure.isOfKind` true). -/
def regionsOfKind (s : Scene) (k : StructureKind) : List RegionId :=
  (s.structures.filter (·.isOfKind k == some true)).map (·.id)
/-- The regions a quantifier over a kind ranges over: those whose membership of the kind is not
    false (`Structure.isOfKind`), the known members and those that may be members. -/
def regionCandidates (s : Scene) (k : StructureKind) : List RegionId :=
  (s.structures.filter (·.isOfKind k != some false)).map (·.id)

  (sig_warning_lamp s x).map (·.any fun l => l.colour == c && l.mode == m)
def sig_siren (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.siren)
def sig_horn (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.horn)
def sig_hand_signal (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option HandSignal := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.handSignal)
def sig_door_open (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List DoorSide) := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.doorsOpen)
def sig_door_open_side (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (side : DoorSide) : Option Bool := (sig_door_open s x).map (·.contains side)
def sig_compression_brake (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.compressionBrake)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Environment
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def env_darkness (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.darkness
def env_precipitation (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.precipitation
def env_wet_road (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.wetRoad
def env_ice_or_snow (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.iceOrSnow
def env_visibility (s : Scene) : Option Q := s.env.visibility
def env_civil_time (s : Scene) : Option CivilTime := s.env.civilTime

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Relations between road users. Measured where the source supplies them, otherwise computed
-- from kinematics. `none` when a needed kinematic is missing.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rel_centre_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.centreDistance) with
  | some d => some d
  | none => do
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let pb ← kin_position s b
    pure (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub pb pa))

/-- Components of `b`'s position relative to `a` in `a`'s heading frame (longitudinal, lateral). -/
private def relFrame (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) := do
  let pa ← kin_position s a
  let pb ← kin_position s b
  let ha ← kin_heading s a
  Geom.inFrame ha (Geom.vsub pb pa)

/-- The gap between the two bodies: the vector from the nearest point of `a`'s footprint to the
    nearest point of `b`'s, each footprint read with its own heading and extent, given as its
    lengths along and across `a`'s heading (longitudinal, lateral). Neither is ever negative; both
    are zero exactly when the footprints touch or overlap. `none` when either footprint is not
    observed, and when a supplied gap has a negative component. -/
def rel_surface_gap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.surfaceGap) with
  | some g => if Q.isNonneg g.1 && Q.isNonneg g.2 then some g else none
  | none => do
    let fa ← footprint s a
    let fb ← footprint s b
    let d ← Geom.nearestOffset fa fb
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let (lon, lat) ← Geom.inFrame ha d
    pure (Q.abs lon, Q.abs lat)
def rel_surface_gap_longitudinal (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.1)
def rel_surface_gap_lateral (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.2)
/-- The distance between the nearest points of the two bodies, the gap's length: zero on contact
    or overlap, never negative. -/
def rel_surface_gap_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map Geom.norm

/-- `a` and `b` share a lane and `a` is ahead of `b` along `a`'s heading. The lane is any region both
    occupy that is of kind lane (`Structure.isOfKind`): unknown when `a` is ahead and no shared region
    is known to be a lane but one may be. -/
def rel_ahead_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.aAheadOfB) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ra ← rel_occupies_regions s a
    let rb ← rel_occupies_regions s b
    let (lon, _) ← relFrame s a b
    if !Q.lt lon Q.zero then some false
    else
      let shared := (s.structures.filter fun st => ra.contains st.id && rb.contains st.id).map (·.isOfKind .lane)
      if shared.contains (some true) then some true
      else if shared.contains none then none
      else some false
def rel_ahead_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s a b
def rel_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s b a

/-- Signed overlap of the two footprints along `a`'s heading, each read with its own heading and
    extent: the length their projections on that axis share, positive when the bodies are side by
    side, otherwise the gap between the projections negated. A projection: it reads nothing across
    the axis, so a positive value is no contact and a negative one no distance between the bodies. -/
def rel_longitudinal_overlap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.longitudinalOverlap) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let u ← Geom.unit ha
    let fa ← footprint s a
    let fb ← footprint s b
    let (loA, hiA) ← Geom.span u pa fa
    let (loB, hiB) ← Geom.span u pa fb
    pure (Q.sub (Q.min hiA hiB) (Q.max loA loB))

/-- Headings opposed (cosine below `-cosTol`) and the distance decreasing. -/
def rel_oncoming (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.oncoming) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let hb ← kin_heading s b
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let pb ← kin_position s b
    let va ← kin_velocity s a
    let vb ← kin_velocity s b
    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
    let closing := Q.lt (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub pb pa) (Geom.vsub vb va)) Q.zero
    pure (Q.lt (Geom.dot ua ub) (Q.neg cosTol) && closing)

/-- Headings aligned (cosine above `cosTol`). -/
def rel_same_direction (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.sameDirection) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let hb ← kin_heading s b
    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
    pure (Q.gt (Geom.dot ua ub) cosTol)

/-- `b` relative to `a` in `a`'s frame: (longitudinal, lateral), lateral positive to the left. -/
def rel_bearing (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Vec :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.bearing) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => relFrame s a b
def rel_bearing_right (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.2 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_left (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.2 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_ahead (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.1 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_behind (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.1 Q.zero

/-- The bodies touch or overlap. -/
def rel_contact (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.contact) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => (rel_surface_gap s a b).map fun g => Q.le g.1 Q.zero && Q.le g.2 Q.zero

/-- `b` is in `a`'s line of sight, as the source tested it; never computed. -/
def rel_visible (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.relation a b).bind (·.visible)

end TrafficSpec

9	  `evalAll` evaluates a formula bottom-up, each subformula once for the whole trace, so a formula
10	  costs O(|φ| · n log n) per binding: atoms map a scene function over the instants, the temporal

15	  Primitives.lean; a name the tables do not know, a wrong arity, a literal that spells no
16	  enumeration value or a variable of the wrong sort is `unknown (malformed …)`. The static check
17	  (RuleEval.check) finds every such defect from the syntax before any trace is read, so a checked
18	  rule reports at evaluation time only source absence, truncation, sampling gaps, undefined
19	  concept preconditions, division by zero and unknown compositions.
20	
21	  Finite-trace policy — unobserved is unknown, never compliance:
22	  - `holdsFor` needs its whole window observed at adequate density, else unknown;
23	  - `within`/`untilWithin` are true on a witness, false only when the window is covered;
24	  - `eventually`/`until` carry the unobserved future, `since` the unobserved past, and `always`
25	    the unobserved future as unknown: on a finite trace `always φ` is false or unknown, never true.
26	    A rule's obligation is written for an instant; the sweep over instants (Grounding) is the
27	    "always".
28	
29	  Rule composition is a callback, because the library of rules is defined above this file.

340	/-- Whether a name is known to either table (the doctor holds this against `atomIds`). -/
341	def knowsAtom (n : String) : Bool :=
342	  let s : Scene := { t := 0 }
343	  let isUnknown : Except UnknownReason R → Bool
344	    | .error e => e == unknownAtom n
345	    | _ => false
346	  let isUnknownQ : QR → Bool
347	    | .error e => e == unknownAtom n
348	    | _ => false
349	  !(isUnknown (evalAtomE s n [] []) && isUnknownQ (evalMeasure s n []))

351	/-- The sort each entity argument of an atom must have (`none` marks a literal position): by
352	    family, with the mixed atoms listed. `none` for a name the tables do not know. -/
353	def atomArgSorts (name : String) : Option (List (Option EntityKind)) :=
354	  let t := some EntityKind.track; let r := some EntityKind.region; let d := some EntityKind.device
355	  match name with
356	  | "rel_occupies" => some [t, r]
357	  | "ru_aggregate" => some [t, none]
358	  | "dev_governs" => some [d, r]
359	  | "st_region_geometry_distance" | "st_sight_along_way" => some [t, r]
360	  | "st_lane_adjacency" => some [r, none, r]
361	  | "st_lane_adjacency_left" | "st_lane_adjacency_right" | "st_lane_connectivity" | "st_lane_enters" | "st_on_way"
362	  | "st_entrance_of" => some [r, r]
363	  | "st_lane_marking" => some [r, none, none, none]
364	  | "rel_oncoming" | "rel_same_direction" | "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" | "rel_ahead_in_lane"
365	  | "rel_behind_in_lane" | "rel_contact" | "rel_visible" | "rel_centre_distance" | "rel_longitudinal_overlap" => some [t, t]
366	  | "rel_surface_gap" | "rel_bearing" => some [t, t, none]
367	  | n =>
368	    if !knowsAtom n then none
369	    else if n.startsWith "env_" || n == "kin_time" then some []
370	    else if n.startsWith "ru_" || n.startsWith "kin_" || n.startsWith "sig_" then some [t, none, none]
371	    else if n.startsWith "st_" then some [r, none, none]
372	    else if n.startsWith "dev_" then some [d, none, none]
373	    else none

381	def constU (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : Array R := const n (R.u w)
382	def constE (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : Array QR := Array.replicate n (.error w)
383	def liftA (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array R)) : Array R :=

390	/-- A term that names no instant: a literal, a parameter or arithmetic over those. Only such a
391	    term may parametrize an atom or a derived concept. -/
392	partial def Term.isConstant : Term → Bool
393	  | .lit _ _ | .param _ => true
394	  | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => Term.isConstant a && Term.isConstant b
395	  | .neg a | .abs a => Term.isConstant a
396	  | _ => false

401	  arr[0]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)

446	/-- φ where the precondition holds; undefined where it is false; the precondition's reasons where
447	    it is unknown. -/
448	def definedWhenR (pre x : R) : R :=
449	  match pre.v with
450	  | .t => x
451	  | .f => R.u (.undefined "defined_when")
452	  | .u => ⟨.u, pre.why⟩

454	/-- A selection at one instant: the branch the guard picks; where the guard is unknown, the
455	    branches' common value, else unknown with the guard's reasons. -/
456	def condAt (g : R) (a b : QR) : QR :=
457	  match g.v with
458	  | .t => a
459	  | .f => b
460	  | .u => match a, b with
461	    | .ok x, .ok y => if Q.eq x y then .ok x else .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))
462	    | _, _ => .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))

464	/-- An aggregate over the members present at one instant: unknown when a member's membership is
465	    unknown or a member's value is; `count` on an empty set is zero, the others are undefined. -/
466	def aggregateAt (op : AggOp) (xs : List (R × QR)) : QR :=
467	  match xs.find? (fun (f, _) => f.v == .u) with
468	  | some (f, _) => .error (f.why.head?.getD (.malformed "aggregate"))
469	  | none =>
470	    let vals := xs.filterMap fun (f, q) => if f.v == .t then some q else none
471	    match op with
472	    | .count => .ok (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat vals.length))
473	    | _ => do
474	      let qs ← vals.mapM fun q => q
475	      if qs.isEmpty then .error (.undefined "aggregate")
476	      else
477	        let sorted := qs.toArray.qsort (fun a b => Q.lt a b)
478	        match op with
479	        | .min => .ok sorted[0]!
480	        | .max => .ok sorted[sorted.size - 1]!
481	        | _ => .ok sorted[sorted.size / 2]!

483	/-- Membership of a road user in a legal aggregate at one scene: true when it carries an included
484	    class; unknown, with the observation's reason, when an included or unresolved class it might
485	    carry is unobserved; unknown as `aggregateUnresolved` when it carries a class the definition
486	    leaves unresolved; false otherwise. -/
487	def aggregateMembership (s : Scene) (t : TrackId) (a : LegalAggregate) : R :=
488	  let classes := fun (ids : List String) => ids.filterMap fun i => RoadUserClass.ofString (i.drop 3).toString
489	  match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.included) with
490	  | some true => R.t
491	  | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")
492	  | some false =>
493	    match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.unresolved) with
494	    | some true => R.u (.aggregateUnresolved a.id)
495	    | some false => R.f
496	    | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")

498	/-- Kleene aggregate at each instant over the evaluated members present in that scene. -/
499	def perScene (c : SemCtx) (evaluated : List (Nat × Array R))
500	    (presentIn : Scene → Nat → Bool) (agg : List R → R) : Array R :=
501	  (Array.range c.n).map fun i =>
502	    let s := c.scenes[i]!
503	    agg (evaluated.filterMap fun (m, arr) => if presentIn s m then some arr[i]! else none)
504	
505	mutual
506	  def evalTAll (c : SemCtx) : Term → Array QR
507	    | .lit v _ => Array.replicate c.n (.ok v)
508	    | .param p => Array.replicate c.n (match c.d.ρ.param p with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.parameterMissing p))
509	    | .measure a args =>
510	      match resolveAll c.β args with
511	      | .error w => constE c.n w
512	      | .ok ds => c.scenes.map fun s => evalMeasure s a ds
513	    | .quantity concept args ps =>
514	      liftQ c.n do
515	        let vs ← constParams c ps
516	        Primitives.evalQ concept c.d (← resolveAll c.β args) vs
517	    | .distanceWhile subj φ =>
518	      match c.β.track subj with
519	      | none => constE c.n (.unboundVariable subj)
520	      | some x => Primitives.distanceWhile c.d x (evalAll c φ)
521	    | .sinceRise φ => sinceRiseAll c.d.times (evalAll c φ)
522	    | .headingSince subj g ψ =>
523	      match c.β.track subj with
524	      | none => constE c.n (.unboundVariable subj)
525	      | some x => liftQ c.n do
526	          let gv ← stepOf g (evalTAll c g)
527	          pure (Primitives.headingSince c.d x gv (evalAll c ψ))
528	    | .aggregate op v φ t =>
529	      let members := (usersOf c).map fun u =>
530	        let c' := c.bindVar v (.track u)
531	        (u, evalAll c' φ, evalTAll c' t)
532	      (Array.range c.n).map fun i =>
533	        let s := c.scenes[i]!
534	        aggregateAt op (members.filterMap fun (u, fa, ta) => if s.tracks.contains u then some (fa[i]!, ta[i]!) else none)
535	    | .add a b' => qzip Q.add (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
536	    | .sub a b' => qzip Q.sub (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
537	    | .mul a b' => qzip Q.mul (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
538	    | .div a b' => Array.zipWith (fun x y => do
539	        let d ← y
540	        if Q.isZero d then .error (.divisionByZero "div") else pure (Q.div (← x) d)) (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
541	    | .neg a => (evalTAll c a).map (·.map Q.neg)
542	    | .abs a => (evalTAll c a).map (·.map Q.abs)
543	    | .cond φ a b' =>
544	      let g := evalAll c φ; let x := evalTAll c a; let y := evalTAll c b'
545	      (Array.range c.n).map fun i => condAt (g[i]?.getD (R.u .outOfRange)) (x[i]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)) (y[i]?.getD (.error .outOfRange))
546	  termination_by t => sizeOf t
547	
548	  /-- Parameters of an atom or derived concept: constant terms, evaluated once. -/
549	  def constParams (c : SemCtx) : List Term → Except UnknownReason (List Q)
550	    | [] => .ok []
551	    | t :: rest => do
552	      let v ← constOf t (evalTAll c t)
553	      pure (v :: (← constParams c rest))
554	  termination_by ts => sizeOf ts
555	
556	  def evalAll (c : SemCtx) : Formula → Array R
557	    | .tt => const c.n R.t
558	    | .ff => const c.n R.f
559	    | .atom name args ps =>
560	      liftA c.n do
561	        let vs ← constParams c ps
562	        let ds ← resolveAll c.β args
563	        if name == "ru_aggregate" then
564	          pure (match ds with
565	            | [.v t, .s id] =>
566	              match c.d.aggregateOverrides.find? (fun (x, a, _) => x == t && a == id) with
567	              | some (_, _, v) => const c.n (R.ofBool v)
568	              | none =>
569	                match c.d.ρ.aggregate id with
570	                | none => const c.n (R.u (.parameterMissing s!"aggregate:{id}"))
571	                | some a => c.scenes.map fun s => aggregateMembership s t a
572	            | _ => const c.n (R.u (.malformed "aggregate arguments")))
573	        else pure (c.scenes.map fun s => match evalAtomE s name ds vs with | .ok r => r | .error w => R.u w)
574	    | .cmp l op r => Array.zipWith (fun x y => match x, y with
575	        | .ok a, .ok b => R.ofBool (op.apply a b)
576	        | .error w, _ | _, .error w => R.u w) (evalTAll c l) (evalTAll c r)
577	    | .asm id => c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (s.assumption id) (.assumptionMissing id)
578	    | .intent id who target =>
579	      match who, target with
580	      | .var a, .var b =>
581	        match c.β.lookup a, c.β.lookup b with
582	        | some (.track x), some (.region r) => c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (s.intention id x r) (.intentionMissing id)
583	        | none, _ => constU c.n (.unboundVariable a)
584	        | _, none => constU c.n (.unboundVariable b)
585	        | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "intent: a track and a region expected")
586	      | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "intent: a track and a region expected")
587	    | .same a b =>
588	      match resolve c.β a, resolve c.β b with
589	      | .ok (.v i), .ok (.v j) => const c.n (R.ofBool (i == j))
590	      | .error w, _ | _, .error w => constU c.n w
591	      | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "same: entities expected")
592	    | .not φ => mapNot (evalAll c φ)
593	    -- a connective whose left operand settles it at every instant does not evaluate its right one
594	    | .and φ ψ =>
595	      let a := evalAll c φ
596	      if a.all (·.v == .f) then a.map (fun _ => R.f) else zipAnd a (evalAll c ψ)
597	    | .or φ ψ =>
598	      let a := evalAll c φ
599	      if a.all (·.v == .t) then a.map (fun _ => R.t) else zipOr a (evalAll c ψ)
600	    | .implies φ ψ =>
601	      let a := evalAll c φ
602	      if a.all (·.v == .f) then a.map (fun _ => R.t) else zipImplies a (evalAll c ψ)
603	    | .always φ => alwaysAll (evalAll c φ)
604	    | .eventually φ => eventuallyAll (evalAll c φ)
605	    | .until φ ψ => untilAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ)
606	    | .since φ ψ => sinceAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ)
607	    | .holdsFor m d subj φ =>
608	      liftA c.n do
609	        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
610	        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
611	        pure (holdsForAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "holdsFor" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ))
612	    | .within m d subj φ =>
613	      liftA c.n do
614	        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
615	        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
616	        pure (withinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "within" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ))
617	    | .untilWithin m d subj φ ψ =>
618	      liftA c.n do
619	        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
620	        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
621	        pure (untilWithinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "untilWithin" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ))
622	    | .atLast m d subj ψ φ =>
623	      liftA c.n do
624	        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
625	        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
626	        pure (atLastAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "atLast" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c ψ) (evalAll c φ))
627	    | .count edge sinceφ op k =>
628	      (countEdgesAll "count" (evalAll c edge) (evalAll c sinceφ)).map fun e => match e with
629	        | .error w => R.u w
630	        | .ok m => R.ofBool (op.apply (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat m)) (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)))
631	    | .rises φ => risesAll (evalAll c φ)
632	    | .definedWhen pre φ => Array.zipWith definedWhenR (evalAll c pre) (evalAll c φ)
633	    | .derived concept args ps =>
634	      liftA c.n do
635	        let vs ← constParams c ps
636	        Primitives.evalB concept c.d (← resolveAll c.β args) vs
637	    | .rule id map =>
638	      let arr := c.compose id map c.β false
639	      if arr.size = c.n then arr else constU c.n (.compositionUnknown id)
640	    | .ruleApplies id map =>
641	      let arr := c.compose id map c.β true
642	      if arr.size = c.n then arr else constU c.n (.compositionUnknown id)
643	    | .existsUser v φ =>
644	      perScene c ((usersOf c).map fun t => (t, evalAll (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ))
645	        (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.any
646	    | .forallUser v φ =>
647	      perScene c ((usersOf c).map fun t => (t, evalAll (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ))
648	        (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.all
649	    | .existsRegion k v φ =>
650	      match regionKindOf k with
651	      | .error w => constU c.n w
652	      | .ok kd => perScene c ((regionsOf c kd).map fun r =>
653	            (r, Array.zipWith R.and (regionIsKind c r kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.region r)) φ)))
654	          (fun s r => (s.structure? r).isSome) R.any
655	    | .forallRegion k v φ =>
656	      match regionKindOf k with
657	      | .error w => constU c.n w
658	      | .ok kd => perScene c ((regionsOf c kd).map fun r =>
659	            (r, Array.zipWith R.implies (regionIsKind c r kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.region r)) φ)))
660	          (fun s r => (s.structure? r).isSome) R.all
661	    | .existsDevice k v φ =>
662	      match deviceKindOf k with
663	      | .error w => constU c.n w
664	      | .ok kd => perScene c ((devicesOf c kd).map fun d =>
665	            (d, Array.zipWith R.and (deviceIsKind c d kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.device d)) φ)))
666	          (fun s d => (s.device d).isSome) R.any
667	    | .forallDevice k v φ =>
668	      match deviceKindOf k with
669	      | .error w => constU c.n w
670	      | .ok kd => perScene c ((devicesOf c kd).map fun d =>
671	            (d, Array.zipWith R.implies (deviceIsKind c d kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.device d)) φ)))
672	          (fun s d => (s.device d).isSome) R.all
673	  termination_by φ => sizeOf φ
674	end

677	def eval (c : SemCtx) (i : Nat) (φ : Formula) : R := (evalAll c φ)[i]?.getD (R.u .outOfRange)
678	def evalTri (c : SemCtx) (i : Nat) (φ : Formula) : Tri := (eval c i φ).v

683	section Lengths

685	private theorem n_bindVar (c : SemCtx) (v : String) (x : Val) : (c.bindVar v x).n = c.n := rfl
686	private theorem size_constU (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : (constU n w).size = n := by
687	  simp [constU, Temporal.size_const]
688	private theorem size_constE (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : (constE n w).size = n := by simp [constE]
689	private theorem size_liftA (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array R))
690	    (h : ∀ a, e = .ok a → a.size = n) : (liftA n e).size = n := by
691	  unfold liftA; cases e with
692	  | ok a => exact h a rfl
693	  | error w => exact size_constU n w
694	private theorem size_liftQ (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array QR))
695	    (h : ∀ a, e = .ok a → a.size = n) : (liftQ n e).size = n := by
696	  unfold liftQ; cases e with
697	  | ok a => exact h a rfl
698	  | error w => exact size_constE n w
699	private theorem size_qzip (f : Q → Q → Q) (a b : Array QR) : (qzip f a b).size = min a.size b.size := by
700	  simp [qzip]
701	private theorem size_perScene (c : SemCtx) (ev : List (Nat × Array R)) (p : Scene → Nat → Bool)
702	    (agg : List R → R) : (perScene c ev p agg).size = c.n := by simp [perScene]
703	
704	mutual
705	  theorem size_evalTAll (c : SemCtx) : ∀ t : Term, (evalTAll c t).size = c.n
706	    | .lit _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
707	    | .param _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
708	    | .measure _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; split <;> simp [size_constE, SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
709	    | .quantity _ args ps => by
710	        rw [evalTAll]; apply size_liftQ; intro a h
711	        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
712	          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
713	        exact Primitives.size_evalQ _ _ _ _ _ h
714	    | .distanceWhile s φ => by
715	        rw [evalTAll]; split
716	        · exact size_constE _ _
717	        · rw [Primitives.size_distanceWhile]; exact size_evalAll c φ
718	    | .sinceRise φ => by rw [evalTAll, Temporal.size_sinceRiseAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
719	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => by
720	        rw [evalTAll]; split
721	        · exact size_constE _ _
722	        · apply size_liftQ; intro a h
723	          cases hg : stepOf g (evalTAll c g) <;> simp only [hg, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;>
724	            try contradiction
725	          cases h; rw [Primitives.size_headingSince]; exact size_evalAll c ψ
726	    | .aggregate _ _ _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
727	    | .add a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
728	    | .sub a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
729	    | .mul a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
730	    | .div a b => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
731	    | .neg a => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_map]; exact size_evalTAll c a
732	    | .abs a => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_map]; exact size_evalTAll c a
733	    | .cond _ _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
734	  termination_by t => sizeOf t
735	
736	  theorem size_evalAll (c : SemCtx) : ∀ φ : Formula, (evalAll c φ).size = c.n
737	    | .tt => by rw [evalAll]; exact Temporal.size_const _ _
738	    | .ff => by rw [evalAll]; exact Temporal.size_const _ _
739	    | .atom name args ps => by
740	        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
741	        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
742	          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
743	        split at h
744	        · cases h; split
745	          · split
746	            · exact Temporal.size_const _ _
747	            · split
748	              · exact Temporal.size_const _ _
749	              · simp [SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
750	          · exact Temporal.size_const _ _
751	        · cases h; simp [SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
752	    | .cmp l _ r => by rw [evalAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalTAll c l, size_evalTAll c r, Nat.min_self]
753	    | .asm _ => by rw [evalAll]; simp [SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
754	    | .intent _ who target => by
755	        cases who <;> cases target <;> rw [evalAll] <;> (repeat' split) <;>
756	          simp [size_constU, SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
757	    | .same a b => by
758	        rw [evalAll]; split <;> simp [size_constU, Temporal.size_const]
759	    | .not φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_mapNot]; exact size_evalAll c φ
760	    | .and φ ψ => by
761	        rw [evalAll]; split
762	        · rw [Array.size_map]; exact size_evalAll c φ
763	        · rw [Temporal.size_zipAnd, size_evalAll c φ, size_evalAll c ψ, Nat.min_self]
764	    | .or φ ψ => by
765	        rw [evalAll]; split
766	        · rw [Array.size_map]; exact size_evalAll c φ
767	        · rw [Temporal.size_zipOr, size_evalAll c φ, size_evalAll c ψ, Nat.min_self]
768	    | .implies φ ψ => by
769	        rw [evalAll]; split
770	        · rw [Array.size_map]; exact size_evalAll c φ
771	        · rw [Temporal.size_zipImplies, size_evalAll c φ, size_evalAll c ψ, Nat.min_self]
772	    | .always φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_alwaysAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
773	    | .eventually φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_eventuallyAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
774	    | .until φ ψ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_untilAll]; exact size_evalAll c ψ
775	    | .since φ ψ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_sinceAll]; exact size_evalAll c ψ
776	    | .holdsFor m d s φ => by
777	        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
778	        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
779	          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
780	        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_holdsForAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
781	    | .within m d s φ => by
782	        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
783	        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
784	          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
785	        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_withinAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
786	    | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => by
787	        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
788	        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
789	          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
790	        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_untilWithinAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
791	    | .atLast m d s ψ φ => by
792	        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
793	        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
794	          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
795	        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_atLastAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
796	    | .count edge sφ _ _ => by rw [evalAll, Array.size_map, Temporal.size_countEdgesAll]; exact size_evalAll c edge
797	    | .rises φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_risesAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
798	    | .definedWhen pre φ => by rw [evalAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalAll c pre, size_evalAll c φ, Nat.min_self]
799	    | .derived _ args ps => by
800	        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
801	        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
802	          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
803	        exact Primitives.size_evalB _ _ _ _ _ h
804	    | .rule _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split <;> simp_all [size_constU]
805	    | .ruleApplies _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split <;> simp_all [size_constU]
806	    | .existsUser _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
807	    | .forallUser _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
808	    | .existsRegion _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
809	    | .forallRegion _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
810	    | .existsDevice _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
811	    | .forallDevice _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
812	  termination_by φ => sizeOf φ
813	end

818	-- Unfolding lemmas: the connectives are the pointwise three-valued operations of Unknown.lean.

820	section Lemmas
821	variable (c : SemCtx) (φ ψ : Formula)
822	
823	theorem evalAll_tt : evalAll c .tt = const c.n R.t := by rw [evalAll]
824	theorem evalAll_ff : evalAll c .ff = const c.n R.f := by rw [evalAll]
825	theorem evalAll_not : evalAll c (.not φ) = (evalAll c φ).map R.not := by rw [evalAll]; rfl
826	private theorem and_of_f (a b : R) (h : a.v = .f) : R.and a b = R.f := by
827	  rcases a with ⟨av, aw⟩; subst h; simp [R.and, R.settle, Tri.and, R.f]
828	private theorem or_of_t (a b : R) (h : a.v = .t) : R.or a b = R.t := by
829	  rcases a with ⟨av, aw⟩; subst h; simp [R.or, R.settle, Tri.or, R.t]
830	private theorem implies_of_f (a b : R) (h : a.v = .f) : R.implies a b = R.t := by
831	  rcases a with ⟨av, aw⟩; subst h; simp [R.implies, R.not, R.or, R.settle, Tri.not, Tri.or, R.t]
832	
833	/-- A connective is the pointwise three-valued operation of its operands' arrays, whether or not
834	    its right operand was evaluated: where the left one settles it at every instant, both arrays
835	    have one value per observation and every pointwise value is the settled one. -/
836	theorem evalAll_and : evalAll c (.and φ ψ) = Array.zipWith R.and (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by
837	  rw [evalAll]; split
838	  · rename_i h
839	    rw [Array.all_eq_true] at h
840	    apply Array.ext
841	    · simp [size_evalAll]
842	    · intro i h1 h2
843	      simp only [Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_zipWith]
844	      rw [and_of_f _ _ (by simpa using h i (by simpa using h1))]
845	  · rfl
846	theorem evalAll_or : evalAll c (.or φ ψ) = Array.zipWith R.or (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by
847	  rw [evalAll]; split
848	  · rename_i h
849	    rw [Array.all_eq_true] at h
850	    apply Array.ext
851	    · simp [size_evalAll]
852	    · intro i h1 h2
853	      simp only [Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_zipWith]
854	      rw [or_of_t _ _ (by simpa using h i (by simpa using h1))]
855	  · rfl
856	theorem evalAll_implies : evalAll c (.implies φ ψ) = Array.zipWith R.implies (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by
857	  rw [evalAll]; split
858	  · rename_i h
859	    rw [Array.all_eq_true] at h
860	    apply Array.ext
861	    · simp [size_evalAll]
862	    · intro i h1 h2
863	      simp only [Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_zipWith]
864	      rw [implies_of_f _ _ (by simpa using h i (by simpa using h1))]
865	  · rfl
866	theorem evalAll_always : evalAll c (.always φ) = alwaysAll (evalAll c φ) := by rw [evalAll]
867	theorem evalAll_eventually : evalAll c (.eventually φ) = eventuallyAll (evalAll c φ) := by rw [evalAll]
868	theorem evalAll_until : evalAll c (.until φ ψ) = untilAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by rw [evalAll]
869	theorem evalAll_since : evalAll c (.since φ ψ) = sinceAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by rw [evalAll]
870	theorem evalAll_rule (id : String) (map : List (String × String)) (h : (c.compose id map c.β false).size = c.n) :
871	    evalAll c (.rule id map) = c.compose id map c.β false := by rw [evalAll]; simp [h]
872	theorem evalAll_ruleApplies (id : String) (map : List (String × String)) (h : (c.compose id map c.β true).size = c.n) :
873	    evalAll c (.ruleApplies id map) = c.compose id map c.β true := by rw [evalAll]; simp [h]
874	
875	/-- The heading-change term is the accumulation operator over its onset's values. -/
876	theorem evalTAll_headingSince (s : String) (g : Term) (x : TrackId) (gv : Q)
877	    (hx : c.β.track s = some x) (hg : stepOf g (evalTAll c g) = .ok gv) :
878	    evalTAll c (.headingSince s g ψ) = Primitives.headingSince c.d x gv (evalAll c ψ) := by
879	  rw [evalTAll]; simp only [hx, hg, liftQ, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure]
880	/-- Unknown is absorbing for `not`, pointwise. -/
881	theorem eval_not_u (i : Nat) (h : (eval c i φ).v = .u) (hi : i < (evalAll c φ).size) : (eval c i (.not φ)).v = .u := by
882	  unfold eval at *
883	  rw [evalAll_not, Array.getElem?_map]
884	  simp only [Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some, R.not_v] at *
885	  rw [h]; rfl
886	end Lemmas
887	
888	end Semantics
889	end TrafficSpec

/-
